reading_h_type_split.source_object: Q is a finite antipodal momentum-shell set with phase-complete coefficients c_k; G_* is the centered isotropic Gaussian-Hartree spectral dressing.
reading_h_type_split.target_object: Psi in H^2(T^3_16;C^3) is a classical mean or condensate field for the hash-pinned P1 functional.
reading_h_type_split.scalar_synthesis: phi_Q(x)=sum_(k in Q)c_k exp(i k dot x), a real finite Bohr-almost-periodic field
reading_h_type_split.discrete_covariance: C_Q(z)=M_x[phi_Q(x+z)phi_Q(x)]=sum_k |c_k|^2 exp(i k dot z), C_Q(0)=I
reading_h_type_split.continuous_covariance: If G_*>=0 and integral G_* d^3q<infinity, C_*(z)=integral exp(i q dot z)G_*(q)d^3q is positive definite and radial.
reading_h_type_split.composite_embedding: K_Q(z)=C_Q(z)P_0 and K_*(z)=C_*(z)P_0 are covariance/composite kernels, not deterministic P1 fields or energy maps.

conditional_commensurate_lift.hypotheses: Q is finite and contained in (2pi/16)Z^3, all c_n are phase-complete, and the registered internal direction u_0 is chosen.
conditional_commensurate_lift.field: Psi_Q(x)=u_0 sum_n c_n exp(2pi i n dot x/16)
conditional_commensurate_lift.boundary: This is a chosen scalar-polarized torus lift. It is not a Reading-H-to-P1 energy or ensemble intertwiner, and fixed I becomes fixed P1 norm.

equivariant_nonextraction.statement: A deterministic translation-equivariant section from stationary covariance-only data to a mean field maps a translation-fixed input to a translation-fixed output. The output is spatially constant and is zero if centering or nonzero-shell support is preserved.
equivariant_nonextraction.consequence: G_* alone cannot select a nonzero BCC mean field. A phase/origin/orientation seed, random or set-valued symmetry breaking, or another non-invariant datum is necessary.
equivariant_nonextraction.scope: This does not obstruct phase-complete (Q,c), covariance/composite observables, or an explicitly symmetry-broken model.

torus_commensurability.machin_formula: pi=16 atan(1/5)-4 atan(1/239), with alternating rational upper and lower sums
torus_commensurability.literal_consequence: (8q0/pi)^2 lies strictly between 3 and 4, so the exact side-16 q0 shell is empty.
torus_commensurability.commensurate_reinterpretation: Replacing q0 by pi sqrt(3)/8 gives only the eight n=(+/-1,+/-1,+/-1) modes.
torus_commensurability.bcc_boundary: The twelve Reading-H BCC {110} directions cannot inject support-preservingly into that eight-mode shell. The R-169 v1.1 support 4{110} has |n|^2=32 and is a wavelength-rescaled combinatorial lift only.
torus_commensurability.escape: A tolerance, shell projection, domain change, off-shell lift, or q0 redefinition requires a declared map and error budget.

nonlinear_convention_firewall.rescaling_obstruction: A fixed amplitude rescaling with unchanged energy units would require s^4=2 and s^6=2 simultaneously.
nonlinear_convention_firewall.full_energy_firewall: The displayed defect is only the bare nonlinear-density mismatch. Math424 also contains Hartree determinant, trial-mass, mixed A-M, and gap terms; P1 has different quadratic parameters plus family, lock, and Class-II terms. No ordering of the full functionals follows.

ensemble_firewall.fixed_intensity: The conditional lift sends fixed Reading-H I to fixed ||Psi||_2^2=4096I.
ensemble_firewall.r157: R-157 is an unconstrained neutral-field theorem. Its energy inequality may test a specified P1 field, but its unconstrained critical/local conclusion is not a constrained-tangent theorem and it does not compare the Reading-H Hartree functional.
ensemble_firewall.r158: R-158 demonstrates that a fixed-charge or chemical-potential problem is a changed variational owner and can admit nonzero shell states without contradicting R-157.
